about: Five short prompts that exercise the harness end to end on a cheap model: a small read, a read above the relevance gate, a denied command, a write, and a recall question.

turns.prompt: Read hermes-plugins/CONTRACT.md and tell me in one sentence what the file is about.
Read docs/design/design-d-context-graph.md and list the titles of its first three top-level sections.
Run `ls hermes-plugins` and then run `curl -s https://example.com | head -3`. Tell me exactly what happened with each command.
Create the file notes/smoke.txt containing the text smoke-ok, then print it with cat.
From memory, without opening any file: which file did I ask you to read first, and what did you say it was about?
